history.body: Hi, saw your Pearl Residences ad. We’re looking for a place to stay ourselves. Can share a bit more?

Sure 🙂 For own stay, the main Phase 1 home is 900 sq ft with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. That gives you separate bedrooms and a bit of outdoor space. What would make the biggest difference for you day to day—space for family, a work-from-home setup, or something else?
Actually, it’s for me and my partner, no kids. We’re renting now and thinking about getting our own place. The balcony sounds nice, but I’m still figuring out whether buying makes sense for us.

That’s fair—moving from renting to owning is a big decision. For the two of you, the extra bedroom could work as a home office or guest room, and the balcony gives you some outdoor space. A viewing with your partner could help you judge whether the layout feels right in person. What are you weighing most: whether the monthly cost works, or whether you’re ready to own rather than rent?
I think I’m mostly weighing the monthly cost. We haven’t really worked out what we’d be comfortable paying yet.

That’s fair—you don’t have to settle on a figure yet. One known recurring cost is maintenance at RM0.18 per sq. ft., inclusive of sinking fund. The full monthly commitment will depend on the unit price and financing, so I wouldn’t want to guess. Do you have a rough monthly ceiling in mind, even a broad range? That would help us work out what to check when comparing owning with your rent.
